messages:
sara-support: Seeing reports of console usage metrics delayed ~3-4 hours for multiple tenants. Dashboards showing zeros since ~01:10 UTC. Any visibility?
ingest-bot: Alert: hourly_ingest_job failed for partition tenants=us-east at 01:12 UTC — Exit 1
sara-support: any idea if this is related to last night's pg maintenance? @lee (Eng-Infra)
lee (Eng-Infra): we ran a minor vacuum+reindex on metrics_write db at 00:50 UTC. Postgres was briefly locked for ~5m. Replication lag peaked at ~2m. That alone shouldn't cause a 4h gap. I'm checking consumer offsets and worker health.
ashok (Eng-ML): pulled kafka metrics — consumer group "console-rollup" shows ~350k lag on topic "hourly-usage" snapshot at 02:00 UTC. Consumer processes were restarted around 01:35.
kira (Data): Airflow shows the hourly rollup DAG retried 3 times for several partitions. Worker pods on node pool-2 were evicted between 01:40-02:05 due to node pressure; logs show OOMKilled for rollup-worker-3.
sara-support: summary so far: pg maintenance -> transient locks -> worker evictions/oom -> consumer backlog -> missing hourly rollups in console. Can we do a targeted backfill for affected tenants and tell customers ETA?
lee (Eng-Infra): bumped node autoscaler thresholds and drained affected node to prevent further evictions. Rescheduled the evicted pods. I'm going to do a rolling restart of rollup-worker to pick up updated resource limits. Avoiding force reset of kafka offsets; prefer replay + backfill.
nashok (Eng-ML): I can run a controlled backfill for tenant subset (acme, globex, delta). Plan: snapshot raw_ingest, then run rollup tool for the 22:00-02:00 window. Throttle concurrency to reduce DB pressure.
kira (Data): commands I'm going to run for reproducibility:
```
# snapshot
pg_dump -t raw_usage --schema=public -f /tmp/raw_usage_snapshot.sql
# backfill
python infra/tools/run_rollup.py --tenants acme,globex,delta --start '2026-03-16T22:00Z' --end '2026-03-17T02:00Z' --parallel 4
```
sara-support: thanks — can someone post an ETA for when dashboards will start showing corrected numbers? customers are pinging support threads.
nashok (Eng-ML): kicking off backfill now, estimating ~40m for that window at current parallelism. I'll post updates when the first rows land in metrics_write.
ingest-bot: Job backfill_rollup_20260317 started by nashok at 03:10 UTC
sara-support: noted. I'll tell customers ETA ~40m and will update when you confirm completion.
lee (Eng-Infra): adding a temporary alert to watch for worker OOM evictions and node pressure for the next 6h.
nashok (Eng-ML): backfill finished for acme, globex, delta. First dashboards are showing non-zero values; remaining tenants are in queue and will finish in next 20m.
sara-support: verified on acme — metrics returned. Will close escalation after 15m of no regressions. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
